But they say "使用20為底" maybe meaning use 20 as the base for the logarithm. But earlier they said "以先前燃料值為底". So maybe they want to compute log(distance) with base equal to previous fuel value (which is 50.0 gallons). But then "使用20為底" might be a mistake.
